label: KPI prueba one click
description: KPI de prueba para flujo generar-validar-registrar
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_coordina f WHERE f.Realizado = 255 {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Volumen mensual total
description: Cantidad total de actividad realizada por período.
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_coordina f WHERE f.Realizado = 255 {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Volumen de cirugias
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, COUNT(*) AS value FROM dat_cirugia d JOIN flow_coordina f ON f.Cod = d.CodCoordina WHERE f.FechaRealizado > '1900-01-01' {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Volumen de PTCA
description: Cantidad de procedimientos PTCA por periodo
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, COUNT(*) AS value FROM call_ptcamaster c JOIN flow_coordina f ON f.Cod = c.CodCoordina WHERE f.FechaRealizado > '1900-01-01' {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Mortalidad al egreso
description: Porcentaje de pacientes fallecidos al egreso hospitalario
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.FechaFallece > '1900-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS value FROM flow_procedimientocardiologia p JOIN flow_coordina f ON f.CodPacFicha = p.CodPacFicha WHERE p.FechaEgreso > '1900-01-01' {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Mortalidad a 30 dias
description: Porcentaje de pacientes fallecidos dentro de 30 dias
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.FechaFallece > '1900-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS value FROM flow_procedimientocardiologia p JOIN flow_coordina f ON f.CodPacFicha = p.CodPacFicha WHERE p.FechaEgreso > '1900-01-01' {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Estadia promedio UCI
description: Promedio de dias de internacion en UCI
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, ROUND(AVG(d.POestadiaUCI), 2) AS value FROM dat_cirugia d JOIN flow_coordina f ON f.Cod = d.CodCoordina WHERE f.FechaRealizado > '1900-01-01' AND d.POestadiaUCI >= 0 {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Espera promedio
description: Promedio de dias de espera entre coordinacion y realizado
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(f.FechaRealizado, f.FechaCoordina)), 2) AS value FROM flow_coordina f WHERE f.FechaRealizado > '1900-01-01' AND f.FechaCoordina > '1900-01-01' AND DATEDIFF(f.FechaRealizado, f.FechaCoordina) >= 0 {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Participacion PTCA
description: Porcentaje de PTCA sobre el total de actividad (PTCA + cirugias)
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.Cod) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT d.k_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT c.Cod), 0), 2) AS value FROM flow_coordina f LEFT JOIN dat_cirugia d ON d.CodCoordina = f.Cod LEFT JOIN call_ptcamaster c ON c.CodCoordina = f.Cod WHERE f.FechaRealizado > '1900-01-01' {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Reingreso a 30 dias
description: Pacientes readmitidos en los 30 dias posteriores.
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, COUNT(*) AS value FROM flow_coordina f WHERE f.Realizado = 255 AND (f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo = 105 OR f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo = 109 OR f.CodCoordinaReglaMotivo = 120) {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period

label: Espera mayor a 30 dias
description: Porcentaje de pacientes con espera superior a 30 dias entre coordinacion y realizado.
sql_query_template: SELECT {period_expr} AS period, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(f.FechaRealizado, f.FechaCoordina) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS value FROM flow_coordina f WHERE f.FechaRealizado > '1900-01-01' AND f.FechaCoordina > '1900-01-01' AND DATEDIFF(f.FechaRealizado, f.FechaCoordina) >= 0 {date_clause} GROUP BY {period_expr} ORDER BY period
